mentions.name: Euclase
mentions.description: A desktop app that acts as a creative harness for generative AI, unifying various image and video generation tools (local ComfyUI and closed APIs) into one cohesive interface, with integrated agents that can pilot the whole workflow. Currently in beta and testable, with onboarding and docs being refined before a wider release.
mentions.audience: Aims to serve both technical creatives and less technical ones, with agent integration helping less technical users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Euclase: http://euclase.ai - the creative harness for generative AI

Unifying all the various image/video gen (comfyui for local, api for closed) in one cohesive desktop app, with integrated agents to pilot the whole thing (if you want).
